_comment: StrykerJS. Copy to the frontend root. Run scoped: npx stryker run --mutate 'src/features/quotes/**/*.ts'
_thresholds: break is the only one that fails CI. Start at 0, measure, then raise it to what you actually hold.
_mutate: Scope every run. Business logic and hooks are worth mutating; presentational components are not — a survived mutation in JSX layout tells you nothing you would act on.
_ignorers: String-literal mutations in i18n keys generate noise, not signal.
_incremental: Reuses the previous run for unchanged files — the difference between minutes and hours on a repeat run.
